name: BiggerPicture
long_description:
BiggerPicture is a freight appointment network. Carriers, shippers and warehouses schedule from one shared shipment record, each in their own view.

Carriers and brokers automate appointment booking across customer portals and email, with an exception queue for anything that needs a person. Warehouses run their docks and yards with a live dock schedule, QR driver self check-in, detention tracking and carrier compliance scorecards. Shippers see every order across facilities and grade carriers on the same compliance standard their warehouses use.

Because every party sees the same record, a confirmed time updates everyone at once. No reconciling emails, portals and spreadsheets.

BiggerPicture runs the largest freight scheduling network. Founded in 2020 by Deema Adada and Guillaume Lo Re. SOC 2 Type I certified.
one_liner: The freight appointment network for carriers, shippers and warehouses

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Deema spent 15 years in leadership roles at Coyote Logistics and Uber Freight, driving significant innovation in the supply chain industry.  During that time, she felt the acute challenges of siloed technology and workflows across the supply chain resulted in less than 1% of shipments could be handled without human intervention, which propelled her to found BiggerPicture.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: During his 13 years working at startups as well as hyper-growth companies such as Datadog and Dassault Systèmes, Guillaume developed a passion for solving complex problems with simple solutions. He takes pride in shaping and crafting stunning user experiences for high volume and critical applications.
